pages.title: Psychical Excursion: Lucid Dreaming, Meditation, Visualization & OBE Research
pages.description: A free researched practice guide for lucid dreaming, meditation, visualization, and out-of-body experience. Public pages use aggregate analytics. Journal entries stay on this device.

pages.title: Remember Your Dreams: Dream Recall Techniques and Research
pages.description: Dream recall techniques and research for noticing and remembering more of the night’s dreams.

pages.title: Notice Your Dreams: Dream Awareness, Patterns and Dream Signs
pages.description: How to notice dream awareness, repeating patterns, and dream signs without forcing a story onto the night.

pages.title: Recognize the Dream: Lucid Dreaming, Reality Checks and Dream Signs
pages.description: Lucid dreaming practice that uses reality checks and dream signs to recognize the dream while it is happening.

pages.title: Feel the Body: Body Scan Meditation and Deep Relaxation
pages.description: Body scan meditation and deep relaxation as a way to feel the body before sleep-edge practice.

pages.title: Move Your Attention: Focused Attention and Body Awareness Meditation
pages.description: Focused attention and body-awareness meditation for moving attention through the body without forcing results.

pages.title: Build the Current: Tingling, Energy Sensations and Focused Attention
pages.description: Tingling and energy-like sensations as objects of focused attention, kept distinct from interpretation.

pages.title: Quiet the Mind: Meditation Techniques for Sleep and Dream Awareness
pages.description: Meditation techniques that quiet mental noise around sleep so dream awareness can be noticed.

pages.title: See the Image: Visualization, Mental Imagery and Hypnagogic Imagery
pages.description: Visualization and hypnagogic imagery as they appear near sleep, including how images form and fade.

pages.title: Watch the Edge: Hypnagogia and the Transition Into Lucid Dreaming
pages.description: Watching hypnagogia and the sleep-edge transition without treating every image as a finished dream.

pages.title: Let the Body Sleep: The “Mind Awake, Body Asleep” Route to Lucid Dreaming
pages.description: The mind-awake, body-asleep route to lucid dreaming, including how awareness and the sleeping body can diverge.

pages.title: Move Without Moving: Motor Imagery, Dream Movement and Sleep-Onset Practice
pages.description: Motor imagery and imagined movement while the physical body stays still, as sleep-onset practice.

pages.title: Feel the Shift: Vibrations, Floating and Out-of-Body Sensations Near Sleep
pages.description: Vibrations, floating, and out-of-body sensations near sleep, tracked as changes in bodily self rather than a single event.

pages.title: Know the Threshold: How to Recognize When Waking Imagery Becomes a Dream
pages.description: How to notice the threshold where waking imagery begins to continue as a dream, without diagnosing a sleep stage.

pages.title: Stabilize the Dream: Lucid Dream Stabilization Techniques and Research
pages.description: Lucid dream stabilization techniques and research, keeping lucidity, stability, and control distinct.

pages.title: Explore the Dream: Lucid Dream Experiments, Dream Control and Research
pages.description: Lucid dream experiments that keep exploration, dream control, and externally verified facts distinct.

pages.title: Loosen the Body: Body Ownership, Self-Location and Out-of-Body Experience
pages.description: How body ownership, self-location, perspective, and vestibular-motor experience can loosen independently near sleep, without treating an OBE as proven literal separation.

pages.title: Cross the Threshold: Astral Projection, OBE Techniques and Lucid Dreaming
pages.description: Astral projection, OBE techniques, and lucid-dreaming entry methods compared at the sleep-edge threshold, without treating rope or roll-out methods as proven separation.

pages.title: Test the Experience: Can Lucid Dreams and Out-of-Body Experiences Be Verified?
pages.description: How to test lucid-dream and out-of-body claims with pre-specified hidden targets, without treating vividness as proof or AWARE as a final verdict.
